status: Provisional ordinary-speed first-life targets for playtesting, not approved release balance
scope: Fresh authors, free editing, no acceleration. No lifetime-count or retirement targets are set here.

targets.reason: An early career choice within one to four real minutes.
A first publication within roughly two to five minutes when writing starts immediately.
A modest paid home retained for a game year within seven to twenty-five real minutes.

independence: Not required in the first life. Report both first qualification and duration sustained; later-life pacing remains deferred.
editing: Paid editing should be an optional investment. Measure extra receipts, readership, costs and delays before setting a return target.
limitedCatalogue: Stopping after three early books must eventually produce zero current sales; saved cash is retained.
